About Anja

Passion, Heart & Expertise

My professional makeup services enhance your natural bridal beauty, ensuring you have that perfect radiant glow on one of your most important days.

With experience and passion, I accompany you on this journey to create unforgettable moments for a magical wedding day.

My journey into the world of beauty began in 2014, when I graduated as a certified Makeup Artist and Hairstylist from a renowned academy in Germany. That year, I didn't just gain a degree — I fulfilled a lifelong dream by turning my deepest passion into my profession.

To me, makeup is so much more than just foundation, eyeshadow, or the perfect lip color. It is a powerful tool to underline your unique beauty and reflect the light you already carry within.

11+ Years of experience

The Signature Glow — My Philosophy

The Signature Glow is more than just a makeup style — it is the very essence of my philosophy. I designed this look for the bride who wants to feel like the most beautiful, polished version of herself. My approach is deeply collaborative: I believe that the perfect bridal look is a reflection of your personality. Whether you rarely wear makeup or follow every beauty trend, I take the time to listen to your ideas and integrate your specific wishes. Together, we create a style that focuses on what matters most: your natural glow and your absolute comfort.

More Than Just a Service

What truly fills my heart is the connection with people. Being chosen to accompany a bride on the most important day of her life is a responsibility I hold with immense pride and gratitude.

An Emotional Anchor

Beyond the brushes and hairpins, I am there to support you emotionally. Whether it's a calming word during the morning jitters or ensuring you feel like the most confident version of yourself — I am by your side.

Professionalism Meets Soul

With over a decade of experience, I combine technical precision with a creative soul. My goal: when you look in the mirror, you shouldn't see a mask — you should see yourself, only more radiant.

Beauty That Lasts

Using professional techniques and premium products, I ensure your hair and makeup stays flawless from the first "I do" to the final dance.

Payment

A 50% deposit is paid at your trial session to secure your date. The remaining 50% is due on your wedding day.

Travel

Anja comes to you — at your home, hotel or venue. Travel costs are charged at €0.30 per km from Amsterdam city center, for both trial and wedding day.

Sundays & Public Holidays

A surcharge applies: Sundays +25% and Public holidays +50% on the total service price.

Booking

Currently booking for 2025 & 2026 weddings. Trial sessions by appointment. Early booking recommended.
